summary.text: Brian Glorioso is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 90, representing St. Tammany, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2023 as the year elected.

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Brian Glorioso's occupation as Attorney.
It lists Brian Glorioso's education as Holy Cross High School; BGS, University of New Orleans; J.D., Loyola Law School.
The House member page lists Brian Glorioso's committee assignments as Civil Law and Procedure; Insurance; Labor and Industrial Relations.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus; Northshore Delegation.
